name: doc-maker
description: Generate .docx and .odt documents based on any existing .doc, .docx, or .odt reference template while preserving exact formatting, styles, images, and tables.

interface.shortDescription: Generate .docx and .odt documents from any reference template
interface.longDescription: Inspect and fill .doc, .docx, and .odt reference templates with new Markdown/text material, images, and dynamic tables while preserving exact XML formatting.
defaultPrompt: Use doc-maker to generate a .docx and .odt from this template.
Inspect this reference document and fill it with my material.
